verses.en: It is reported commonly that there is fornication among you, and such fornication as is not so much as named among the Gentiles, that one should have his father's wife.
verses.sm: Ua salalau le tala o ia te outou le faitaaga, o le faitaaga faapea foi e le o taʻua i nuu ese, ina ua fai ava le tasi i le ava a lona tamá.

verses.en: And ye are puffed up, and have not rather mourned, that he that hath done this deed might be taken away from among you.
verses.sm: O outou foi, ua outou loto fefete ea? A e tou te le faanoanoa ea, ina ia tuueseina ia te outou le ua faia lena mea?

verses.en: For I verily, as absent in body, but present in spirit, have judged already, as though I were present, concerning him that hath so done this deed,
verses.sm: O aʻu foi, o loo le i ai loʻu tino ia te outou, a ua ia te outou lo'u loto, ua uma ona ou faamasino i le ua faia faapea lena mea, peiseai ua ou i ai lava;

verses.en: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when ye are gathered together, and my spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.sm: pe a faapotopotoina outou faatasi ma lo‘u agaga, ma le mana o lo tatou AW o Iesu Keriso, i le suafa o lo tatou Alii o Iesu Keriso,

verses.en: To deliver such an one unto Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.
verses.sm: tou te tuuina atu ai le ua faapea ia Satani, e fano ai le tino, ina ia sao le agaga i le aso o le Alii o Iesu.

verses.en: Your glorying is not good. Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?
verses.sm: E le tusa lo outou mitamita. Tou te le iloa ea o se mea faafefete itiiti, e faafefeteina ai le palugafalaoa uma lava?

verses.en: Purge out therefore the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, as ye are unleavened. For even Christ our passover is sacrificed for us:
verses.sm: O le mea lea ia outou faatea ese ai le mea faafefete tuai, ina ia avea outou ma paluga fou, ona ua leai o se mea faafefete ia te outou; aua foi o Keriso la tatou paseka ua fasia mo i tatou.

verses.en: Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness; but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
verses.sm: O lenei, aua tatou te faia le tausamiga ma le mea faafefete tuai, o le loto leaga ma le amio leaga; a ia faia ma le mea e le faafefeteina, o le loto lelei ma le faamaoni.

verses.en: I wrote unto you in an epistle not to company with fornicators:
verses.sm: Ua ou tusi atu ia te outou i laʻu tusi, aua tou te feoai ma e faitaaga;

verses.en: Yet not altogether with the fornicators of this world, or with the covetous, or extortioners, or with idolaters; for then must ye needs go out of the world.
verses.sm: to e le faasino lea'i e faitaaga o lenei lalolagi, atoa ma e matapeapea, ma e fao mea, ma e ifo i tupua; ana faapea, e ao ina outou o ese atu i le lalolagi.

verses.en: But now I have written unto you not to keep company, if any man that is called a brother be a fornicator, or covetous, or an idolater, or a railer, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; with such an one no not to eat.
verses.sm: A o lenei, ua ou tusi atu ia te outou, ai se tasi ua ta‘uusoina a e faitaaga, pe matapeapea, pe ifo i tupua, pe agatele, pe onà, pe fao mea; aua lava neʻi tou feoai, aua foi tou te aai faatasi ma le o faapea.

verses.en: For what have I to do to judge them also that are without? do not ye judge them that are within?
verses.sm: Aua o ia te au ea ona faamasino i e ua i tua? O outou E faamasino i E ua i totonu;

verses.en: But them that are without God judgeth. Therefore put away from among yourselves that wicked person.
verses.sm: a 0 E i tua, e faamasinoina i latou e le Atua. O lenei, ia faateaeseina e outou lena tagata amio leaga ia te outou.
